The meanings are different, but I am not sure, do we need that level of precision in this dictionary? I also hesitated to split the (1) meaning in hwy ‘werden, entstehen’: we have werden-entstehen ‘возникать’ and werden-verwandeln ‘становиться кем-то или чем-то’. I think in the case of hwy this range of meaning of werden is natural, like in old Russian становиться has these two meanings (И стал свет), though in modern Russian it is impossible (И появился свет).
